AssayDetails: Assessment: Instrumental measurement - Corneometer. Biochemical measurements Lactic acid on skin (μg/cm2) AMP -  Psoriasin (S100A7) ng/sample Impact of prebiotics on skin health On first visit (day 1) subjects were grouped based on study groups each cell (n = 10).   Baseline values of skin parameters and microbiome samples were collected. Each participant was given two products GTC gel (control/Placebo and test consisting of (Glycerol/Pentavitin/FOS). All participants used the products as instructed for two weeks and samples were collected on day14 of product use. Microbiome samples from two spots were pooled and taken for 16S analysis. The samples taken for molecular analysis i.e., DNA isolation and sequences on Illumina MiSeq machine. 2x250 bp with 0.1 M read depth using V1-V2 primers. Templates made and validated by internal expert were used for metadata capture at the study site.
objectives: Primary: Within a cell, evaluate and compare two leave-on skin care formulations for their ability to improve lactic acid levels on the skin after 2 days and 2 weeks of use. Secondary: Within a cell, determine and compare two leave-on cosmetic skin care formulations for their impact on skin condition, specifically antimicrobial peptide (AMP) levels, skin hydration and barrier function (trans epidermal water loss, TEWL), after 2 days and 2 weeks of use and microbiome after 2 weeks of use. Exploratory: Compare the leave-on products across cells for different endpoints.
